To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ovarian biometry, follicles and oocyes yield and oocyte yield of Baladi goat was higher during breeding than non-breeding season.
the goat ovaries bearing CL in non-breeding and breeding seasons yielded better oocyte yield than ovaries without CL.
the goat ovaries with CL in non-breeding seasons yielded better oocyte quality than in breeding season.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possibility of using the oocytes recovered from slaughtered goat does as a source of oocytes for IVM/IVF in goat breeding programs.
the effect of ovarian condition on oocyte yield and quality of Baladi goat in breeding and nonbreeding seasons.
the ovarian biometry and oocyte yield and quality of Baladi goat as affected by breeding season and CL bearing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the oocytes yield and quality were better in the ovaries bearing CL than non-bearing ones, and this was independent of breeding season.
the oocytes yield and oocyte qualities were affected by season and ovarian status.

the ovarian biometry of Baladi goat ovaries was higher during the breeding season than in the non-breeding season and this may reflect the effect of season on the ovarian activity and folliculogenesis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the oocytes from Baladi goats ovaries with CL in breeding season are better in terms of oocytes quality than in nonbreeding season, while the oocytes from goat ovaries without bearing CL are more available during non-breeding season than in breeding season.
, the best time for oocytes collection from Baladi goat ovaries was in non-breeding period from slaughtered goats without CL.
, the ovaries bearing CL in breeding season had better yield than in non-breeder ones, but the quality was not affected significantly.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, the oocytes yield and quality of Baladi goat ovaries are not significantly influenced by the season, however, the oocytes harvested in the breeding season are more mature than in the non-breeding season.
, the ovarian biometry was not affected by the presence of CL.
the oocyte quality was not affected by the season, but the oocyte yield was affected.
